title: Nigeria Geopolitical Zones
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for Nigeria's six geopolitical zones.
methodology: Independently compiled and cross-verified factual reference data. SoftData follows the geopolitical-zone classification used by the National Bureau of Statistics (https://microdata.nigerianstat.gov.ng/index.php/catalog/55/study-description), UBEC (https://ubec.gov.ng/zonal-and-state-offices/) and the Niger State Government (https://nigerstate.gov.ng/about/), under which Niger State belongs to North Central. An RMAFC organizational-structure page (https://rmafc.gov.ng/structure/) groups Niger with a North-West operational office; this was treated as an agency-specific operational arrangement rather than a general geopolitical reclassification.
